# GitHub Projects Configuration

## Project Boards

### 🚀 Roadmap
- **Purpose**: Track long-term goals and milestones
- **Columns**: Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done
- **Labels**: roadmap, milestone, epic

### 🐛 Bug Tracking
- **Purpose**: Track and prioritize bug fixes
- **Columns**: New, Confirmed, In Progress, Testing, Done
- **Labels**: bug, priority-high, priority-medium, priority-low

### ✨ Feature Development
- **Purpose**: Track new feature development
- **Columns**: Ideas, Planned, In Progress, Review, Done
- **Labels**: enhancement, feature, new-feature

### 📚 Documentation
- **Purpose**: Track documentation improvements
- **Columns**: Needs Documentation, In Progress, Review, Published
- **Labels**: documentation, docs, help-wanted

### 🧪 Testing
- **Purpose**: Track testing and quality assurance
- **Columns**: Test Cases, In Progress, Review, Passed
- **Labels**: testing, test, quality-assurance

### 🔒 Security
- **Purpose**: Track security-related issues
- **Columns**: Reported, Investigating, Fixing, Verified
- **Labels**: security, vulnerability, security-fix

## Workflow

### 1. Issue Creation
- Create issue with appropriate labels
- Assign to relevant project board
- Set priority and milestone

### 2. Development
- Move to "In Progress" when work starts
- Update progress in comments
- Link related PRs

### 3. Review
- Move to "Review" when ready
- Request reviews from team
- Address feedback

### 4. Completion
- Move to "Done" when complete
- Close issue
- Update documentation

## Labels

### Priority
- `priority-critical`: Critical issues requiring immediate attention
- `priority-high`: High priority issues
- `priority-medium`: Medium priority issues
- `priority-low`: Low priority issues

### Type
- `bug`: Something isn't working
- `enhancement`: New feature or request
- `documentation`: Improvements or additions to documentation
- `good-first-issue`: Good for newcomers
- `help-wanted`: Extra attention is needed

### Area
- `area-fractal`: Related to fractal systems
- `area-api`: Related to API
- `area-blockchain`: Related to blockchain
- `area-consensus`: Related to consensus
- `area-security`: Related to security
- `area-performance`: Related to performance

### Status
- `status-needs-triage`: Needs initial review
- `status-needs-design`: Needs design work
- `status-needs-implementation`: Ready for implementation
- `status-needs-testing`: Needs testing
- `status-needs-review`: Needs code review

## Automation

### Auto-assignment
- Issues are automatically assigned based on labels
- PRs are automatically linked to issues
- Milestones are automatically updated

### Notifications
- Team members are notified of new issues
- Stakeholders are notified of priority changes
- Community is notified of releases
